description: This file defines the Map.Drag handler for the Leaflet mapping library, enabling map dragging with inertia, including options for bounds and zoom handling.

classes.name: Drag
classes.description: A handler class extending Leaflet's Handler to enable map dragging with inertia and bounds constraints.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Initializes dragging, sets up event listeners, and enables the draggable object.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Removes event listeners and disables dragging.

methods.name: moved
methods.description: Returns whether the map has been moved via dragging.

methods.name: moving
methods.description: Returns whether the map is currently being moved via dragging.

methods.name: _onDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag, stops map movement, and sets bounds constraints.

methods.name: _onDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging motion, updates position and fire move/drag events.

methods.name: _prunePositions
methods.description: Removes old position records to limit stored data for inertia calculations.

methods.name: _onZoomEnd
methods.description: Updates offset and world width after zooming.

methods.name: _viscousLimit
methods.description: Applies viscosity to limit the drag beyond bounds.

methods.name: _onPreDragLimit
methods.description: Prevents dragging outside bounds with viscous effect.

methods.name: _onPreDragWrap
methods.description: Handles map wrapping when dragging across world boundaries.

methods.name: _onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a drag, calculates inertia, and initiates animated panning if applicable.
